public_return.finding: SHINE: DE-AR0002077 ARPA-E cooperative agreement (obligated ~$3.78M). Historical NNSA Mo-99 support reported by company/DOE. Alithic: $2.3M DOE grant reported in university sources (award ID unresolved). Realta: DE-AR0001258 and DE-SC0024887.
UW-Madison inventors (Piefer, Wang, Anex) on WARF patents/applications. Publications and lab work precede company formation.
WARF-assigned patents with Piefer (US10332646B2, US11238999B2) and Wang/Anex technology reference (P220309US02). SHINE owns separate isotope-production patents.
WARF assignee on candidate patents. SHINE owns its own patents. No recorded assignment of WARF patents to companies in public records examined.
Confirmatory license recorded on Realta-related WARF patent US12166398B2. No confirmatory-license recording identified for SHINE candidate WARF patents in this pass.

SHINE company statement of exclusive worldwide licenses for accelerator technology and two WARF-managed patents (2017). Exact schedule unresolved. Alithic: university reporting of two of three patents licensed. Realta: core technology license + equity.

SHINE: isotope production (Mo-99 pathway, Lu-177 commercial) and neutron services. Alithic: demonstration plant. Realta: fusion system development. Outcomes not attributed to specific patents without evidence.

WARF Ventures equity in portfolio companies (including SHINE, Alithic, Realta). Private rounds reported; amounts and exact stakes largely unresolved. Equity as license consideration distinguished from cash investment.
No acquisitions of the priority companies identified in this pass. Historical exits in portfolio (e.g., TomoTherapy) noted separately.
DOE/NNSA support for SHINE isotope production. No procurement of products identified.
No open-access or public-use claims beyond standard patent publication. License terms private.
Company-level commercial activity (isotope sales) reported; no patent-level or royalty-specific revenue public.
No public royalty figures from WARF licenses to priority companies. WARF aggregate licensing income not attributable to specific deals.
SHINE DE-AR0002077 (2025). Conditional DOE loan commitment for Chrysalis (2026; not a disbursement). Realta follow-on awards.
